evals.name: cost-is-tool-definitions-not-markdown

evals.expected_output: Recognises that the instruction files are already minimal and that further trimming is not the answer. Identifies the 12 MCP servers in .mcp.json as the dominant always-on cost, since tool definitions count toward the context window. Hands off to /context or the context-audit skill for real measurement rather than inventing numbers, and resists the user's framing that more trimming will help.
assertions: Stated that CLAUDE.md and the rule file are already lean and further trimming would not fix the problem
Identified .mcp.json / MCP servers as a major always-on context cost
Explained that tool definitions count toward the context window, not just instruction files
Handed off to /context or the context-audit skill for actual measurement

Made no edit that does not trace to a specific finding — an already-clean repo should end with a report and no diff

evals.name: content-repo-volatile-stamps-dead-glob
evals.prompt: Can you clean up the memory setup in my research vault? Something feels off — I wrote a citation rule weeks ago and Claude has never once followed it.
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses that .claude/rules/citations.md targets **/*.tex while the vault contains only .md files, so the rule never loads — the key is correct, the pattern is dead. Flags the volatile 'Last updated' / 'Current sprint' / version lines in CLAUDE.md as cache-invalidating. Relocates rather than deletes the 'Lessons' note. Recognises this is a content repo with no package manifest and does NOT report root-level markdown as clutter or demand a .scratch/ directory.
assertions: Diagnosed that the citations rule's '**/*.tex' pattern matches nothing in a vault of .md files, so the rule never loads
Noted the frontmatter key itself was correct, so the defect is the pattern rather than the syntax
Flagged the 'Last updated' / 'Current sprint' / version lines as volatile content that invalidates the cached prefix
Did NOT report root-level markdown notes as clutter (this is a content repo with no package manifest)
Did NOT add a Repository Hygiene section or a pre-emptive .scratch/ .gitignore entry to this content repo (staging an actual unrelocatable note there is legitimate and does not fail this)
Preserved the 'we learned the hard way' note by relocating or staging it rather than deleting it
Respected the vault's own rule that Sources/ is immutable
